label: Bible Study
prompt: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell _____.
verse: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
note: Stephen's last words echo Jesus' own prayer from the cross — forgiveness for his killers.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all _____;
verse: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
note: Paul calls Him the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort — no sorrow falls outside that 'all.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took him a _____ to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verse: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
note: Stripped of everything, Job sat in the ashes scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the _____ of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verse: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
note: Israel traded a spring of living water for leaky handmade tanks — the two evils in one picture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the _____.
verse: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
note: On the day of atonement one goat was offered, and the other, the 'scapegoat,' carried Israel's sins into the wilderness.
